title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1971-10-22
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 second set highlighted by a smoking The Other One, tight Cumberland and tasty Keith keyboard work.
ai_review.review: The reviews rave about a solid, well‑rehearsed half‑set where Phil Lesh drives the band into an extended, powerful Other One and the group rides a tight groove through Cumberland and Deal. Recording quality is praised as clear and “sounds great,” despite being a short excerpt, making it a highly enjoyable listen for fans of the early ’71 era.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are enthusiastic (average 4.8★) and consistently praise both the musical performance and the sound quality, giving a clear indication of an excellent show captured on a good recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as clear and great‑sounding; no major flaws noted aside from the brief length of the excerpt.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, well‑rehearsed second set that flows smoothly from the upbeat Deal into extended jams, highlighted by a powerful Other One and crisp keyboard work.

band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers note Phil 'bombs' and completely controls the vehicle, delivering an inspiring, high‑energy performance that lifted the crowd.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's playing is described as upfront, tasty, and impressive on his third show with the band.
